text: PyAirbyte is a Python library bringing Airbyte capabilities to Python and AI developers
quote: PyAirbyte brings the power of Airbyte to every Python and AI developer.

text: Terraform provider lets you manage Airbyte configuration as version-controlled code
quote: you can use Airbyte's Terraform provider to automate and version control your Airbyte configuration as code.

text: Airbyte exposes a REST API to programmatically control syncs, usable with orchestrators like Airflow
quote: Use the Airbyte API to programmatically interact with Airbyte. For example, you can control Airbyte in conjunction with orchestration tools like Airflow.

text: Connector Builder is a no-code UI tool for building connectors without leaving Airbyte
quote: Connector Builder is a no-code tool that's part of the Airbyte UI... letting you develop a connector to use in data syncs

text: AI Assistant auto-fills and configures fields in the Connector Builder to speed up connector creation
quote: AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder

text: Airbyte Agents let MCP-capable tools (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, Codex) connect to your data
quote: Connect MCP-capable agents like Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and Codex to your data through Airbyte Agents.

text: Sync modes define the combined behavior of how a source is read and a destination is written
quote: A sync mode governs how Airbyte reads from a source and writes to a destination.

text: Connections can be scheduled via Scheduled, Cron, or Manual trigger options
quote: The three options for `Schedule Type` are: Scheduled, Cron, Manual

text: Built-in notification system sends alerts to email and/or webhook for sync events
quote: Airbyte can send notifications to an email address, webhook, or both.

text: Connection Timeline shows historical sync events and lets you view/download logs
quote: The Connection Timeline displays historical information about relevant connection events. You can also view and download logs

text: dbt Cloud integration runs dbt transformations automatically right after a sync completes
quote: By using the dbt Cloud integration, you can create and run dbt transformations immediately following syncs in Airbyte Cloud.

text: Quickstart lets you deploy a local instance of open-source Airbyte Core in minutes
quote: This quickstart guides you through deploying a local instance of Airbyte Core, Airbyte's open source product. Setup only takes a few minutes

text: abctl CLI makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is available
quote: abctl makes it easy to run Airbyte anywhere Docker is running.

text: Each connection can be configured with a chosen policy for handling upstream schema changes
quote: You can specify for each connection how Airbyte should handle any change of schema in the source.

text: Airbyte can consume database log files (CDC) to capture insert/update/delete changes without heavy source load
quote: A consumer of these log files (such as Airbyte) can read these logs while keeping track of the current position within the logs in order to read all record changes coming from DELETE/INSERT/UPDATE statements.

text: Programmatic API access requires an access token for authentication
quote: Most programmatic interactions with Airbyte require an access token.

text: Incremental sync mode pulls only data changed since the previous sync
quote: An incremental sync is a sync which pulls only the data that has changed since the previous sync

text: Data lands with one-to-one stream-to-table mapping, avoiding scattered sub-tables
quote: One-to-one table mapping: Data in one stream will always be mapped to one table in your data warehouse. No more sub-tables.

text: Airbyte can be installed into any Kubernetes cluster
quote: This installation guide walks through how to deploy Airbyte into _any_ kubernetes cluster.

text: Catalog offers 600+/700+ maintained connectors across APIs, databases, warehouses, and lakes
quote: Airbyte provides a catalog of 600+ connectors for APIs, databases, data warehouses, data lakes

text: Consolidates data from hundreds of sources into data warehouses, lakes, and databases
quote: Consolidate data from hundreds of sources into your data warehouses, data lakes, and databases.

text: PyAirbyte can extract data into local caches, useful for Jupyter/prototyping without running a server
quote: Data can be extracted from sources and loaded into caches

text: Offers a 30-day free trial including 400 usage credits
quote: Start with a 30-day free trial. 400 credits included ($2,000 of usage).

quote: Equip your agents to query, search, and act on your data in real-time
